'''Xarovit Tovar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and [[Imperial Guard]]sman in service to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3637 BBY]], Tovar was stationed on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] as a commander of Imperial forces while both they and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] acted in concert to bring an end to the newly realized threat posed by the fanatical [[Order of Revan]] cult.<ref name="SWTOR" />
